name: ZX_AR_COND_ACTIONS_ALL
description: The AR_TAX_CONDITION_ACTIONS_ALL table stores actions for each tax condition that you define in the Tax Groups window. You can specify multiple actions for both True or False conditions.  . The primary keys for this table are TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_ID, TAX_CONDITION_ID, TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_TYPE, and DISPLAY_ORDER.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier, used to identify the expression line record for each within a tax condition

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Part of the primary key, identifies the tax condition that this set of actions belongs to

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Part of the Primary key - identifies if this set of actions is TRUE or FALSE.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Part of the primary key - controls the display order of each action.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the action to be taken (for example: Error Message, Use Tax Code, Apply Exception), based on the TAX_CONDITION_ACTION lookup type

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ACTION_VALUE
columns.description: Optional value, used in conjunction with the condition action.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.
